records.text: Xavier Poussard wrote Becoming Brigitte and had never been sued for defamation, according to Candace Owens
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Xavier Poussard is the person who wrote the "Becoming Brigitte" book. ... He has never been sued for defamation

verification.notes: Current reporting confirms that Xavier Poussard wrote and self-published Devenir Brigitte / Becoming Brigitte. The categorical statement that he had never been sued for defamation could not be established from an exhaustive official litigation record. Current reporting describes a separate cyberharassment investigation involving Poussard, while also distinguishing that proceeding from defamation litigation. Authorship is confirmed; the universal no-defamation-suit claim remains insufficiently documented.

records.text: Candace Owens interviewed Xavier Poussard in London on December 21
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: As you can see on the timeline, on December 21st, I interview Xavier Poussard in London. We did not release it, right?

verification.notes: The transcript context provides Owens's dated first-person account, and her later published in-person interview with Xavier Poussard confirms that the interview occurred. Her later Tucker Carlson interview also places her in London when she agreed to and conducted the Poussard interview. The exact December 21 date rests on Owens's primary account rather than an independent contemporaneous calendar record, so confidence is medium.

records.text: Candace Owens said she received the first cease-and-desist letter from Brigitte Macron and her lawyers on December 3 before interviewing Xavier Poussard
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Suddenly, on December 3rd, before I interview him, I receive the first ever cease-and-desist letter from Brigitte Macron and her lawyers.

verification.notes: Confirmed through multiple sources. Court documents and news reports verify that the Macrons sent their first retraction demand/cease-and-desist to Owens in December 2024. CBS News, Fortune, and the Delaware Superior Court complaint all reference this December 2024 cease-and-desist. The exact date of December 3rd is a specific personal detail that cannot be independently verified from public sources, but the December 2024 timeframe is well-documented.
